# PDF.js vendor files

This directory contains the minimal runtime files used by the custom lesson PDF viewer.

- Package: `pdfjs-dist`
- Version: `6.3.289`
- Source: `https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist`
- Downloaded files:
  - `build/pdf.mjs`
  - `build/pdf.worker.mjs`

The app does not use Mozilla's default viewer UI, examples, source maps, or a frontend build system.
